scope: Complete pretrained 30-block shape flow, 512 synthetic active voxels, level-0 PJRT, stock LoRA. Original and candidate use identical seeded tensors and a stock FP32 CPU reference. Resident weights; fresh input/output transfer and synchronization included.
finding: Avoiding the complex-pair layout lowers a complete forward from 2.231s to 0.627s (3.56x) in this comparison. CPU preparation is bitwise equal at the model output; device relative error is slightly lower than baseline and no fallback is reported.
decision: Retain as an opt-in execution candidate pending 6181-token, other-flow, matched-trajectory and real-scene quality validation. No production-default change and no end-to-end speedup claim.
